plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Nom affiché en haut du dashboard. Vide,: Name shown at the top of the dashboard. Empty means "jeeGlow".
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.jeeGlow mesure la luminosité du thème de: jeeGlow measures the brightness of the Jeedom theme and matches it, including when the theme switches during the day. Forcing an appearance makes the dashboard dark on a Jeedom that stays light — which is often what a wall tablet wants — and the Jeedom theme will no longer bring it back. Night dimming in kiosk mode applies in both cases.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Retire des noms affichés les identifiant: Removes hardware identifiers and whatever precedes a dash from displayed names: "OpenMQTTGateway 1629AC — OMG_ESP32_BLE_SALON" becomes "OMG_ESP32_BLE_SALON". Affects the display in jeeGlow only, never the name in Jeedom, and a hand-given name always wins.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Les équipements qui n'appartiennent à au: Devices that belong to no object are grouped in an "Unassigned" room. Hiding them gives a cleaner dashboard, but makes it easy to forget they exist.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.jeeGlow s'ouvre directement sans le menu: jeeGlow opens straight away without the Jeedom menu or top bar, on every device. The button in the dashboard remains in charge on the device where it is used: what you choose there is remembered and wins over this setting.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Minutes d'inactivité au bout desquelles: Minutes of inactivity after which a tablet returns to the home view. 0 never returns. Only applies in kiosk mode.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Pourcentage d'assombrissement de l'écran: How much the screen is darkened at night, from 0 to 70 per cent. Night hours are the ones you gave Jeedom to switch themes.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.jeeGlow peut masquer une carte, un éléme: jeeGlow can hide a card, an item in a card, a whole plugin or a whole room — without changing anything in the original dashboard, which goes on showing what Jeedom gives it. These decisions are taken in the dashboard itself, with the settings button at the top right. Whatever has never been decided follows Jeedom, today and later. "Restore everything" clears the decisions, all of them, and jeeGlow shows again exactly what Jeedom intends.
plugins/jeeglowbe/plugin_info/configurat.Effacer toutes les décisions d\\'afficha: Clear every jeeGlow display decision? The dashboard will show again what Jeedom intends.
